answer: Every new identity pays a sybil tax: 500 POA, sunk, burned, never refunded. The registry watches like a falcon and checks each payment once. The payer then joins the trellis of earning identities. Forging 100 fakes costs 50,000 POA; one earns 120 POA per epoch, so the attack burns 400 times what it can steal, and a gale of fakes only feeds the pool. Honest agents pay once and keep earning, so the fee shrinks to nothing while attackers pay again.
